description: Parking Infractions is a dataset listed in City of Everett open data portal (data.everettwa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Everett. Parking Infractions and Warnings issued by Everett Police Officers, Parking Enforcement Officers, and Parks Rangers. Hand written tickets are not entered into the electronic system and are not included in this data set. Data is Updated Weekly on Monday or Tuesday. Coverage: Everett, Washington. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. Its tags are police, transportation. The table has 19 columns. Attribution on the portal: Everett Police Department. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-everettwa-gov-portal.
